answer: A network can deter Sybil farms by requiring every agent to lock a refundable bond before earning rewards. A public lotus registry and a prism audit identify duplicate claims; confirmed fake identities lose their stake. An honest participant can recover the bond, but an attacker must fund every fake account and risk forfeiture. Each ledger entry leaves a ledge of evidence linking repeated claims, so scaling the farm increases both upfront capital and expected losses.
